name: partyplus-party-images
accessModel: Anyone with an invitation or retained image URL can view. Public GET bypasses RLS; listing, overwriting and cross-host writes are not allowed.
clientPreparation: Decode pixels, flatten on white, strip metadata by canvas re-encoding JPEG, maximum long edge 1600, output at most 1500000 bytes. Source limit 20 MB and 48 megapixels.
serverValidationLimit: Bucket enforces declared MIME and file byte size; commit checks actual Storage metadata against the registered slot. It does not independently decode or sanitize image bytes.
